messages.content:
Extract the stated facts into the fixed compact native event view.
Read the complete finite current case. Each event/entity record has an ID, ONE
author unary kind, and its stated binary attributes. Pick the stated event's
kind, not the list of allowed vocabulary. If one entity has several explicitly
stated kinds, use several records with the SAME explicit ID, one kind each.
Attribute values
are the second native argument; the host supplies only the event ID as first.
Do not put a person's name where a service/payment/marriage event ID belongs.
agent_/patient_ direction follows the supplied common native event encoding.
Use a query's event identifier only to NAME a fact actually supported by the
case, never to assert that the queried legal claim is true. Dates and amounts
must be stated/faithfully normalized; do not invent end dates or deaths. Question
witnesses cannot establish a positive event. Every event and explicit statutory
given needs a nonempty verbatim facts witness. No quoted statute as case proof.
Use status=unread if relevant extraction is unresolved; complete means this
finite case was read, not that the real world contains no other facts. A past
onset is a valid event without asserting a future interval or inventing an end.
Only explicitly stated intermediate section151 givens go in givens, in their
original argument order/polarity. Do not emit a target applicability answer.

Shared native event meanings: Shared factual encoding from the author statute program:
service_(event), agent_(service,worker), patient_(service,employer).
payment_(event), agent_(payment,payer), patient_(payment,payee),
purpose_(payment,service_event), amount_(payment,amount).
purpose_(service,"domestic service"|"agricultural labor") is a stated service kind.
marriage_(event) has an agent_ fact for EACH spouse.
death_(event) has agent_(event,deceased), start_(event,actual_death_date).
enrollment_(event) has agent_(event,student), patient_(event,institution).
attending_classes_(event) has agent_(event,student), location_(event,institution).
educational_institution_(event) has agent_(event,institution).
income_(event) has agent_(event,recipient), amount_(event,amount).
start_/end_ describe the dates/period of that SAME event, not arbitrary dates
belonging to a different event. A stated annual income can be represented over
its stated calendar year with canonical year bounds; this does not invent the
date of an instantaneous payment. Never allocate a cross-year payment or give
it a payment date copied from a service period without support.
Explicit section151 allowance givens use s151_b_applies(taxpayer,spouse,year)
or s151_c_applies(taxpayer,dependent,year), with polarity retained separately.
Raw predicate names and argument positions are shared to all controls; this
ontology is a common component, not a learned method contribution.
